answer: When k identities coordinate equivocation, the protocol aggregates correlated evidence and scales slashing quadratically, with exposure proportional to k² rather than k. A sybil operator therefore cannot cheaply multiply influence: bonded collateral is confiscated across the swarm, and detection applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss as penalties compound across linked escrows. This ripple effect makes a willow-thin identity split no safer than standing alone on an island.
